clip_dinoiser_cityscapes_core.description: Paper target: CLIP-DINOiser on Cityscapes improves mIoU over the default averaged-template classifier while using top-4 class experts from the fixed 80-template pool. This workspace reports a synthetic dense-feature substitute under the same target.

mIoU.description: Mean intersection-over-union on the slice, matching the paper's headline dense segmentation metric.

pixel_accuracy.description: Overall held-out pixel classification accuracy, included to catch broad segmentation regressions not fully reflected by IoU.

mean_class_accuracy.description: Unweighted mean per-class recall, included to catch shortcuts that improve common regions while neglecting smaller classes.

rare_class_mIoU.description: Mean IoU over below-median-frequency classes in the slice, included to penalize background- or layout-biased segmenters.

boundary_pixel_accuracy.description: Pixel accuracy restricted to ground-truth class-boundary pixels, included to catch coarse mask shortcuts.

num_experts_per_class.description: Number of selected class-specific artifacts per class; lower is better under the fixed small-budget constraint.

num_templates.description: Total fixed text-representation pool size available to the method; lower is better to discourage expanding the pool.

clip_dinoiser_cityscapes_low_data.description: Paper target: CLIP-DINOiser on Cityscapes with very few unlabeled expert-selection images still improves over the default averaged-template classifier. This workspace reports a synthetic dense-feature substitute under the same target.

mIoU.description: Mean intersection-over-union on the low-data slice, matching the paper's headline dense segmentation metric.

pixel_accuracy.description: Overall held-out pixel classification accuracy, included to catch broad segmentation regressions not fully reflected by IoU.

mean_class_accuracy.description: Unweighted mean per-class recall, included to catch shortcuts that improve common regions while neglecting smaller classes.

rare_class_mIoU.description: Mean IoU over below-median-frequency classes in the low-data slice, included to penalize background- or layout-biased segmenters.

boundary_pixel_accuracy.description: Pixel accuracy restricted to ground-truth class-boundary pixels, included to catch coarse mask shortcuts.

num_experts_per_class.description: Number of selected class-specific artifacts per class; lower is better under the fixed small-budget constraint.

num_templates.description: Total fixed text-representation pool size available to the method; lower is better to discourage expanding the pool.

expert_quality_clip_dinoiser_cityscapes_.description: Paper target: entropy-selected CLIP-DINOiser top-4 class experts substantially overlap with oracle class experts. This workspace reports the analogous diagnostic on hidden synthetic oracle expert sets.

expert_precision_pct.description: Percent overlap between selected and hidden oracle class-specific artifacts on the evaluated class subset.

num_experts_per_class.description: Number of selected class-specific artifacts per class; lower is better under the fixed small-budget constraint.

num_templates.description: Total fixed text-representation pool size available to the method; lower is better to discourage expanding the pool.
